notes: ADR-0009 queue: per-aggregate FIFO, stable idempotency keys, backoff+jitter, 8 attempts, conflict surfaced. Storage port; IndexedDB adapter and UI banner belong to apps/pwa.
Pure cache policy, response cacheability, versioned cache names and purge lists. Service worker registration itself lives in apps/pwa.
Manifest builder/validator and install-prompt state machine with 14 day cooldown. Persisting InstallState (localStorage) is the PWA's job.
JSON logger, metrics + Prometheus text, health registry, SLO budgets. Relay must supply sink, scrape endpoint and checks; no tracing.
Signed v1 snapshots, verify, empty-store restore, GFS retention. Blob encryption at rest is the BackupStore's job; restore is a library call, not an operation.
Checkpointed replay, projection rebuild, outbox redelivery, three DR runbooks, drill tracking with RTO judgement. Replay is synchronous (matches the sync store).
Module registry: unique ids, flag validation, single owner per event/collection, dependency report, per-tenant listing. Other packages register via registerModules.
FlagService: dependencies with cycle detection, tenant overrides, static+runtime kill switch, cached evaluation, audited admin ops. Catalog names must be reconciled with packages.
Tenant CRUD with expectedVersion, active/suspended machine, limits overrides, operator payee account, assertTenantActive. Enforcement in other packages is the relay's wiring.
37 STRIDE threats over six assets with controls, planned work and status; reviews per tenant. Statuses are claims to re-verify at integration; one threat is open.
Forward-only incident lifecycle, SEV1-4 targets, append-only timeline, postmortem, SLA sweeper. Paging/notification of responders is left to the relay (events only).
Four playbooks (key compromise, data exposure, relay compromise, fraud wave) with tracked execution; recovery blocked while steps are pending. Steps are manual checklists, not automation.
